what: a 7 x 21 rectangle 2.6 mm from a block vertical edge revolved as a symmetric 180 degree cut about that edge: both end faces of the tool lie in the block left face (refused as "could not be computed reliably")
method: block 60 x 20 x 25 (x 0..60, y 0..20); the ring (radii 2.6..9.6, height 21 inside the 25) turns +-90 degrees about the edge x = 0, y = 20; only the quarter with y < 20 lies in the block: V = 30000 - pi (9.6^2 - 2.6^2) 21 / 4 = 28591.467.
